newsitem.title: USA: Sun-Diamond affiliates not included in USDA ban.
newsitem.headline: Sun-Diamond affiliates not included in USDA ban.

text.p: The five affiliates of Sun-Diamond Growers of California were not included in the government's decision on Friday to bar the cooperative from participating in federal purchase programs and can continue selling commodities to the federal government.
"This does not affect the affiliates," said an official with the Agriculture Department's Agriculture Marketing Service, the agency which made the ruling.
"At this time, the government can still purchase products from Sun-Diamond affiliates," the official said.
